title: FlyFork: Experimental deterministic branching simulation from a selected Drosophila connectome circuit
description: FlyFork is an open-source browser lab for reproducible, deterministic branching experiments on an 80-neuron DM1 olfactory circuit (4,011 directed neuron-pair edges; 30,636 internal synapses) derived from MaleCNS v1.0 Drosophila connectome data. Users can capture complete simulated states, fork into Original, Fork A, and Fork B trajectories, apply timed suppression or odor-gain interventions, export/import portable JSON records, and verify own-history replay. This archive contains the FlyFork simulation software, frozen prepared DM1 circuit subset, and verification/test suite. Biological validity is not claimed; dedicated B0/R01/R02 local research runners and raw archives are separate from this public release (see docs/research/overview.md and docs/model.md).
